verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe automatic prompt-prefix caching on serverless endpoints: repeated prompt prefixes still warm in the shared cache are billed at a steep discount with no toggle needed, directly reducing cost on repeated context, and while docs also emphasize this affects cost more directly than latency, it's still the caching feature. missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks quantifying latency or cost savings, and details on cache TTL/eviction/scope.
